newsitem.title: USA: Washington state Gov. names stadium panel members.
newsitem.headline: Washington state Gov. names stadium panel members.

text.p: Washington state Gov. Gary Locke on Tuesday appointed seven members to the state's public stadium authority to oversee the construction and operation of a new football and soccer stadium approved by voters in June.
"The taxpayers deserve an oversight panel that will be a watchdog, not a lapdog," Locke said in a statement.

The governor appointed Lorraine Hine to serve as chairperson of the authority. Hine served as former Gov. Mike Lowry's staff director and before that as his legislative relations director. Locke named Frederick Mendoza, an attorney with Cromwell, Mendoza & Belur, as vice chairman.
* Benson Wong, an attorney with Keller Rohrback
* Lucy DeYoung, president of DeYoung and Company, a financial management firm
* Bob Dilger, executive secretary of the Washington State Building and Construction Trades Council
* Jacob Jundt, a co-owner of Tri-Ply Construction Inc
* Sue Frost, president of Cascade Columbia Foods
Locke said Hine and Mendoza, and two other members to be chosen by lot, would serve four-year terms. The remaining members will serve initial two-year terms.
